rootCauseHypothesis.evidence: In portrait static-spaced natural QA, blade moves upward at vy≈-200 immediately before the tip/normalY=-1 runway anchor. The attempt-1 guard requires relativeNormalVelocity<0 and therefore misses the observed direction; the early anchored path remains active.
rootCauseHypothesis.changeHypothesis: For level1-runway-main only, route any early sharp top-face contact with normalY<=-0.9 through the existing respondToHardSurface path, including separating/upward contacts, instead of anchoring. Do not alter other support IDs, non-top sharp anchors, later x>=350 suppression, blunt bounce, debug fixture bypass, or core physics coefficients. The existing hard-surface response applies separation even when relative normal velocity is nonnegative; verify no persistent recontact and fixed replay stability.
rejectedAlternatives: Attempt-1 approaching-only normal guard: passes unit tests but exact natural contact approaches from the opposite velocity direction and still anchors.
Threshold-only sharp suppression at x>=250 or x>=290: breaks the established normal forward replay before the stack.
Global sharp-anchor suppression: alters authored support behavior outside the runway and is out of scope.
